冷める: to cool down; to get cold
箇所: counter for places, parts, passages, etc.
犯す: to commit (e.g. crime); to perpetrate; to make (e.g. mistake)
落ち合う: to meet up (as arranged); to rendezvous; to get together
仕込む: to insert; to build into; to fit
合流: joining (of people, groups, parties, etc.); union; linking up; merging (e.g. of traffic)
通ずる: to be open (to traffic); to lead (to); to connect (to); to run (from, between; e.g. bus service)
塞がる: to be closed; to be blocked; to be healed (e.g. wound); to be shut up
言い切る: to declare; to assert; to state definitively
小物: minor character; small fry; weak one
踏ん張る: to hold out; to persist; to make an effort; to exert oneself
草臥れる: to become worn out; to become battered (from long use)
使い: errand; mission; going on an errand
突き止める: to determine (esp. a culprit or underlying cause); to pin down; to ascertain; to locate
一方: just keeps; being inclined to ...; tending to be ...; tending to do ...

__flags__.犯す: おかしない = おかしい (strange) + negative, not 'to commit'
__flags__.粉: 買うてこな = 来る+negative (こな), not 'flour'
__flags__.割れ: 割れとる = 割れる 'be exposed/busted' conjugated form, not the noun 'broken piece'
__flags__.早: 早よ = はよ 'quickly', clipped adverbial form
